input.conditions: Copied T elements, pure Combine; no identity needed

output.conditions: Ordered fold for nonempty half-open range; invalid/empty query throws

constraints.limits: size_t, container max_size and allocation limits additionally apply
constraints.numeric_and_state: Copied T elements, pure Combine; no identity needed; Ordered fold for nonempty half-open range; invalid/empty query throws
constraints.errors: Invalid shape/index/domain rejected; allocations may throw; algorithm-specific overflow/tolerance behavior in documentation

complexity.operations: Build O(n log(n+1)) combine/copy; query O(1) combine/copy
complexity.space: sum_k(n-2^k+1) T objects + O(log n) offsets; T dynamic storage extra
complexity.guarantee: Worst-case unless explicitly stated; no calibrated performance claim

memory_lower_bound.scope: Conservative owned payload lower bound on current 64-bit platform, not peak/latency feasibility

relations.condition: Static idempotent folds and nonempty queries; ordinary sums and point updates are excluded

evidence.correctness: Reasoned invariants and reductions in documentation, not formal verification

provenance.implementation: Independently rewritten for this project; source motivates algorithm and constraints
provenance.license: MIT for the project implementation; see LICENSE and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md; no LICENSE was found in the pinned reference snapshot, which is not relicensed here
